claims.text: The dataset HotelRec was created based on hotel reviews from TripAdvisor.
HotelRec contains approximately 50 million reviews, making it the largest publicly available dataset in the hotel domain.
The dataset includes user profiles, hotel URLs, overall ratings, summaries, user-written texts, dates, and sub-ratings.
The dataset was released for further research and is available at a specified URL.
